errors.text_span: Das Diagramm zeigt den Anteil von Ein- und Zweifamilienhäusern in Wohngebieten, der über dem Altbaubestand liegt, in städtischen und ländlichen Regionen zwischen 1984 und 2015.
errors.evidence: This description of the chart's purpose is a complete misinterpretation and conflation of the six distinct categories listed in the legend. The chart shows the percentages for six different types of residential areas, not a single category as described.
The tick marks on the x-axis may be annual, but the tick labels are not at annual intervals. The labels appear at 1984, 1990, 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, and 2015, which is an irregular interval.
The y-axis has a linear scale, not a logarithmic one. The intervals between 0, 5, 10, 15, etc., are evenly spaced.

errors.text_span: Eine blaue gestrichelte Linie stellt die Anteile von Ein- und Zweifamilienhäusern in Wohngebieten in städtischen Regionen dar, die über dem Altbaubestand liegen.
errors.evidence: The line being described (the top-most one, for 'Städtische Regionen, Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser') is a solid blue line with 'x' markers, not a dashed line. The label provided is also a fabrication, combining elements from other legend entries.

errors.text_span: fällt dann bis zum Jahr 2000 auf 27 % und steigt bis 2005 weiter auf 31 % ... und steigt bis 2015 auf 30 %.
errors.evidence: The data points for the first line are incorrect. In 2000, the value is approximately 29% (not 27%). In 2005, it is approximately 29% (not 31%). In 2015, the value is approximately 32% (not 30%).

errors.text_span: Eine grüne gestrichelte Linie stellt die Anteile von Ein- und Zweifamilienhäusern in Wohngebieten in ländlichen Regionen dar, die über dem Altbaubestand liegen.
errors.evidence: The line for rural single- and two-family houses (legend item 5) is a green dotted line, not a dashed ('gestrichelte') line. Furthermore, the label described is incorrect and appears to be hallucinated by combining parts of other labels.

errors.text_span: Der Wert beginnt bei etwa 12 % im Jahr 1984, erreicht 14 % im Jahr 1990, sinkt auf 11 % im Jahr 2000, steigt bis 2005 auf 16 % und sinkt dann bis 2010 auf 13 % und steigt bis 2015 auf 15 % an.
errors.evidence: These values do not correspond to the green dotted line (legend item 5) which is being described. That line starts at approximately 22% in 1984, not 12%. The entire trend description is incorrect for this line.
There is no yellow line in the chart. The lines are blue and green.
The description refers to 'A blue line', but there are four distinct blue lines in the chart. It fails to specify which one by its marker shape, making the description ambiguous.

errors.text_span: stellt die Anteile von städtischen Regionen mit mehrfamilienhäusern über dem Altbaubestand dar
errors.evidence: This label for the 'blaue Linie' is not present in the legend. It appears to be an incorrect mashup of several legend entries.

errors.text_span: beginnend bei etwa 17 % im Jahr 1984 und bis 2015 auf etwas über 23 % gestiegen.
errors.evidence: While one of the blue lines (with square markers, item 4) does start near 17%, it does not rise to over 23% by 2015. In fact, it ends around 17% in 2017 (the last data point), showing no overall increase.

The chart contains six distinct lines, but the description only attempts to describe four, two of which are completely misrepresented or hallucinated. The descriptions for lines 2, 3, and 6 are missing entirely, and the other descriptions are inaccurate.
